reason: The analyst ran only a bivariate OLS with no controls (after an unjustified 1% outcome trim) and got 2.07. My analysis, adjusting for the 2020 pre-period covariates including lagged patents, gives about 0.75, so the raw figure is inflated roughly threefold by confounding. The report ran one specification and did not address confounding or robustness, so the effect size is not well supported.
